summary: Become a certified ISA/IEC 62443 Lead Implementer. Gain essential knowledge to implement robust cybersecurity measures in your organization.
audienceIntro: This PECB ISA/IEC 62443 Lead Implementer course is tailored for professionals who are instrumental in securing industrial automation and control systems and ensuring operational resilience against cyber threats. This course is designed for: IACS Security Managers overseeing the implementation of industrial cybersecurity programs. Control Systems Engineers responsible for securing OT infrastructure and processes. OT Security Architects designing and integrating secure industrial control systems. Industrial Cybersecurity Consultants advising organizations on ISA/IEC 62443 compliance. Risk Managers focused on identifying and mitigating operational technology risks. Compliance Officers ensuring adherence to industrial cybersecurity regulations. Automation Engineers integrating security into new and existing industrial systems. IT/OT Convergence Specialists bridging the gap between enterprise IT and industrial networks. SCADA System Administrators managing the security of supervisory control and data acquisition systems. Critical Infrastructure Protection Specialists safeguarding essential services and assets.
modules: Foundations of IACS Security and ISA/IEC 62443
ISA/IEC 62443 Security Requirements and Threat Landscape
Establishing and Managing an IACS Security Program
IACS Security Operations, Incident Response, and Compliance
prerequisites: A general knowledge of Industrial Automation and Control Systems (IACS) concepts and the ISA/IEC 62443 series of standards is recommended for participants attending this training course. While not strictly mandatory, this foundational understanding will enhance your learning experience and ability to apply the advanced concepts covered.
